_comment: agent-relay managed hooks for Codex CLI. Edits between _agent_relay_managed markers are owned by `relay hooks install/uninstall`. The {RELAY_HOOK_COMMAND} token is replaced by the installer with `<python_interpreter> <hook_script>` (both shell-quoted) so the command does not depend on the host's PATH for shebang resolution; Codex spawns hooks with a stripped PATH. Each entry is APPENDED to ~/.codex/hooks.json's hooks.<Event> array (preserving existing oh-my-codex etc. entries and their trust-key indices).
